goals.title: Zero failed runs per digest window
goals.description: The 3-hourly digest reports failed_runs across the fleet; a healthy fleet holds this at 0 and every failure is named with a cause. Verified emitted key.
directives: Name every failed run with its cause in the digest body
If the same agent fails two consecutive windows, escalate instead of just listing it

goals.title: Keep operator escalations at zero
goals.description: Escalations mean the fleet could not self-heal. Drive toward 0 by making auto-fix playbooks absorb recurring causes. Verified emitted key.
directives: De-dupe repeat escalations (suppressed counter should absorb them)
When an escalation repeats 3+ windows, propose a permanent fix rec

goals.title: Surface continuous shipped-rec flow
goals.description: shipped per window is the fleet's heartbeat of user-facing output; sustained 0 across windows means the pipeline is stalled and the digest must say why. Verified emitted key.
directives: When shipped=0 while queued_recs>0, call out the blocking stage (drainer, pool, defers) in the digest
